title: Relationship Manager
description:
🚀 We’re Hiring at Policybazaar!

Are you looking to kickstart or grow your career in sales? Join Policybazaar, India’s leading online insurance marketplace, and take the next step in your career!

📌 Position: Relationship Manager – Field Sales

📍 Locations: Tiruppur | Trichy

💰 CTC: ₹3.00 – ₹4.25 LPA (Fixed)

🎯 Additional Benefits: Travel Allowance + Unlimited Incentives

🔹 Key Responsibilities

- Drive new customer acquisition and upselling.

- Meet clients, understand their needs, and recommend suitable insurance solutions.

- Build long-term customer relationships and provide post-sales support.

- Develop and execute effective sales strategies within the assigned territory.

🔹 Eligibility Criteria

- Graduates/Postgraduates with relevant experience.

- Must possess a valid Driving Licence (DL) and vehicle Registration Certificate (RC).

- Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

- Passion for field sales and customer engagement.

🌟 Why Join Policybazaar?

- Opportunity to work with a leading insurance brand.

- Excellent career growth and earning potential.

- Performance-driven rewards and incentives.

- Be part of the mission to insure every Indian family by 2047.

📩 Interested candidates, apply now!
